rule: Nothing under inputs changes after a human answers. An edit to any of them after that voids the affected result under the manifest's forbidden_rescues.
keys_note: sha256 of the withheld key file (pre and cold cases). The file is committed to this directory only after every response is in.

decision_rule.narrow_if: 1 ≤ median_A − median_B < 2 → narrow to the two-way sort (rescue vs not-rescue)
kill_if: either arm's cold median fails to beat (is not strictly greater than) its own pre-task median
decision_rule.conclude_only_if: n ≥ 8 with 4 to 5 per arm, scored once at the return deadline in PILOT.md; below that, scripts/trial_score.py exits 2 and nothing is concluded
decision_rule.medians: standard median; with 4 per arm a median can be a half-integer, and the bands above are stated so every value falls in exactly one

primary_outcome: correct sorts out of eight on the cold transfer case
